title: tny dictation dictionary
description: ~/.tny/dictionary.json (user) and <workspace>/.tny/dictionary.json (project; wins per word). Words the transcript normalizer may restore, with known mishearings. Only these entries are sent with a transcript (ADR 0175, docs/dictation.md).

^(?=[^\\x00-\\x1f\\x7f]{1,64}$)(?=.*[0-9.description: A dictionary word: at most 64 bytes, a letter or digit, no surrounding space or control characters.

oneOf.description: Context: what the word means here.

aliases.description: Known mishearings. A correction whose span has more than one word must match one of these.

case.description: exact: the replacement must match the word byte for byte.
